prototype_feel_reasons: The visible book, clipboard, and boar assets are platform-style emoji rather than a cohesive custom game-art set, making the interface feel slightly more provisional than a finished commercial game UI.
Icon scale and visual weight vary: the book and clipboard are prominent while the boar inside the primary action is comparatively tiny.
The assets have no shared framing, rendering style, or controlled color treatment, weakening visual cohesion despite otherwise consistent spacing and containers.
issues: screen/resource-row icons — book and clipboard emoji use inconsistent intrinsic shapes and rendering styles — replace them with a unified custom icon set at a fixed size and optical alignment
screen/primary action — boar emoji is undersized relative to the large button and label — enlarge it slightly and reserve a consistent icon slot with controlled spacing
screen/all illustrated assets — native emoji appearance may vary by operating system and browser — use bundled SVG or raster assets to guarantee consistent commercial presentation
